newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia's net foreign reserves rise slightly.
newsitem.headline: Colombia's net foreign reserves rise slightly.

text.p: Colombia's net foreign reserves rose a modest $300,000 in the third week of September to total $8.067.3 billion, the central bank or Banco de la Republica said.
It said net reserves rose by $8.3 million between August 31 and September 21, the latest period for which official figures are available.
But the balance for the entire year, up until September 21, shows net reserves having fallen by $257.1 million, the central bank said. -- Javier Mozzo, Bogota newsroom, 571 610 7944
